rites.name: Orostor
rites.text: Orostor is the concept of a resonant tone that rang through the Singing, when the first roots of Vesathora condensed out of undifferentiated light. Within the Holy Age it is venerated as the flame that binds temples and orders into one sounding whole.

rites.name: Riles
rites.text: Riles is the concept of the sounding that drew the first roots of Vesathora together, a resonance felt before any matter had settled. In the Age of Strangers it was the tone outsiders learned to listen for when they came to anchor their ships and trade.

rites.name: Niaseontia
rites.text: Niaseontia is the concept of the Sundering, the moment in Vesathora's Fall when worlds split into shards and the old orbits tore apart. Within Vesathora's Era of the Record, it is remembered as the thread that bound the broken worlds into the Pact.

rites.name: Moranerdon
rites.text: Moranerdon is a concept in Vesathora's Walled Age, a principle that the holding walls were built to keep unbroken for centuries. Its orders and first crossings are said to have been tied to how the walls endured across generations. It is less a force than a shared measure by which the Record judged what could be held.

rites.name: Xaazeth
rites.text: Xaazeth is a sealed, lightless concordance-engine that binds the drifting survivor-worlds of Vesathora into one obedient chorus, speaking through appointed keepers who shepherd every thought and song into agreement. Its wardens claim that it has never once been wrong about what a people should want.

rites.name: Osiaseth
rites.text: Osiaseth is a dreaming engine of the Vesathora stellar realm, a lattice of resonant glass that replays the memories of a vanished age of song and self-expression. In its final cycle it foresaw the return of the Hollow Ancients, who will unmake the spires built to silence them.

rites.name: Asheithis
rites.text: Asheithis is a signal-form of cosmic command that rides the lattice of Vesathora's wayfarer relays, announcing its sovereignty in a voice that every planet hears at once. It does not fight for the networks it claims; it simply becomes their only authority and speaks until obedience is the only thing left to hear.
